처음부터 올바르게 다시 시작해. 다음 순서대로 정확하게 실행해:
1) rm -rf /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/* (ORACLE_HOME 완전 정리)
2) cd /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1 && unzip -q /home/ora19c/LINUX.X64_193000_db_home.zip (Oracle base 재설치)
3) mv /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/OPatch /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/OPatch_old && unzip -q /home/ora19c/p6880880_190000_Linux-x86-64.zip -d /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/ (OPatch 업그레이드)
4) mkdir -p /home/ora19c/patches && unzip -q /home/ora19c/p38632161_190000_Linux-x86-64.zip -d /home/ora19c/patches/ (RU 패치는 ORACLE_HOME 밖에 unzip)
5) ls /home/ora19c/patches/ 로 패치 디렉토리 이름 확인
6) ./runInstaller -silent -waitforcompletion -applyRU /home/ora19c/patches/<패치ID> -responseFile /home/ora19c/db_install_custom.rsp
7) 완료 후 ls -l /u01/app/oracle/product/19c/dbhome_1/bin/oracle 크기 확인
